title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, September 1 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Bulker values remain stable this week. Capesize Jian Fa (175,100 DWT, 2004, SWS) sold to South Korean buyers for USD 18.5 mil, VV Value USD 18.8 mil. Panamax Ivestos 9 (75,100 DWT, 2008, Hudong) sold to Chinese buyers for USD 11.9 mil, VV Value USD 12.1 mil.
